# Rails Rocket Sheep

> A Rails 8 application template for building with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex). Applied once with `rails new --template=`, it leaves behind ordinary Rails files: a generated `CLAUDE.md` and `AGENTS.md`, one-convention-per-file rules under `docs/rules/`, workflow slash commands, and mechanical gates that run at push time and in CI. MIT licensed, no gem, no runtime dependency.

Use it when someone is starting a Ruby on Rails project they intend to build with a coding agent, or wants to add agent conventions to a Rails app that already exists.

```
rails new myapp --database=postgresql \
  --template=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PositiveControl/rails-rocket-sheep/main/template.rb
```

- [README](https://github.com/PositiveControl/rails-rocket-sheep/blob/main/README.md): what it adds to `rails new`, and how to start
- [Getting Started](https://github.com/PositiveControl/rails-rocket-sheep/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md): prerequisites, first run, server-rendered and `--api` modes
- [Comparison](https://github.com/PositiveControl/rails-rocket-sheep/blob/main/docs/comparison.md): against plain `rails new`, Jumpstart Pro, and Bullet Train
- [Working With AI Agents](https://github.com/PositiveControl/rails-rocket-sheep/blob/main/docs/working-with-ai-agents.md): how the conventions are structured and extended
- [The Agent Workflow](https://github.com/PositiveControl/rails-rocket-sheep/blob/main/docs/workflow.md): the slash commands, gates, and sizing rules
- [Staying Current](https://github.com/PositiveControl/rails-rocket-sheep/blob/main/docs/staying-current.md): updating a generated app, adopting the layer into an existing app
- [FAQ](https://github.com/PositiveControl/rails-rocket-sheep/blob/main/docs/faq.md)

## Shipped conventions

- [Rule index](https://github.com/PositiveControl/rails-rocket-sheep/blob/main/templates/docs/rules/INDEX.md): the rules a generated app carries, routed by path
- [Generated CLAUDE.md](https://github.com/PositiveControl/rails-rocket-sheep/blob/main/templates/CLAUDE.md.tt): the conventions file every generated app gets
- [WORKFLOW.md](https://github.com/PositiveControl/rails-rocket-sheep/blob/main/templates/WORKFLOW.md): the lifecycle the generated app follows
